text: Wood glue is very strong when pieces fit tight together.
Spread a thin layer on one side.
Clamps squeeze the joint while the glue dries.
Snug is enough. Do not crank them super tight.
Wipe off glue that squeezes out with a damp rag.
Glue left on the wood stops finish from soaking in.
Leave the clamps on for at least 30 minutes.
Wait a full day before you work the joint hard.

tip.text: Read the glue bottle for its times.
